using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.TemplateEngine.Blocks;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

public class VarBlockTests
{
    private readonly Mock<ILogger<VarBlock>> _mockLogger = new();

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_EmptyContent_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        string? content = null;

        // Act
        _ = new VarBlock(content, new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "The variable name is empty"),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void Constructor_ContentLengthLessThan2_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        const string content = "$";

        // Act
        _ = new VarBlock(content, new Mock<ILoggerFactory>().Object);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "The variable name is empty"),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsValid_NullContent_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var block = new TestVarBlock(null);

        // Act
        block.IsValid(out _);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("A variable must start with the symbol $ and have a name")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsValid_EmptyContent_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var block = new TestVarBlock(string.Empty);

        // Act
        block.IsValid(out _);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("A variable must start with the symbol $ and have a name")),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsValid_WrongPrefix_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var block = new TestVarBlock("abc");

        // Act
        block.IsValid(out _);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "A variable must start with the symbol $"),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void IsValid_ContentLengthLessThan2_LogsErrorMessage()
    {
        // Arrange
        var block = new TestVarBlock("$");

        // Act
        block.IsValid(out _);

        // Assert
        _mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.Log(
                LogLevel.Error,
                It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat>((v, t) => v.ToString() == "The variable name is empty"),
                It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
            Times.Once);
    }

    private sealed class TestVarBlock : Block
    {
        public TestVarBlock(string? content) : base(content, Mock.Of<ILoggerFactory>(f => f.CreateLogger<VarBlock>() == _mockLogger.Object))
        {
        }

        public override bool IsValid(out string errorMsg)
        {
            errorMsg = string.Empty;

            if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(this.Content))
            {
                errorMsg = $"A variable must start with the symbol {Symbols.VarPrefix} and have a name";
                this.Logger.LogError(errorMsg);
                return false;
            }

            if (this.Content[0] != Symbols.VarPrefix)
            {
                errorMsg = $"A variable must start with the symbol {Symbols.VarPrefix}";
                this.Logger.LogError(errorMsg);
                return false;
            }

            if (this.Content.Length < 2)
            {
                errorMsg = "The variable name is empty";
                this.Logger.LogError(errorMsg);
                return false;
            }

            return true;
        }
    }
}
